name: SwitchBot Hub 2 (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only per SwitchBot; CSA lists Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. It also has an IR blaster.

matter.note: CSA lists Hub 2 from Woan Technology, Matter 1.3, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Search showed more than one Hub 2 certificate ID; the verifier should check which applies.

apple_home.note: Fullest support; the Hub 2 touch buttons and universal remote work only through Apple Home.

smartthings.note: Added through Partner devices > Matter in the SmartThings app.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's SwitchBot Matter page lists devices certified via Hub 2 or Hub 3.

hubRequired.note: Not applicable to the hub itself; not assessed.

localControl.note: Not confirmed from an official source.

deviceProtocols.note: Talks to SwitchBot Bluetooth devices and IR appliances.

matterBridge.note: Bridges SwitchBot devices only (locks, curtains, blind tilts, meters, some sensors, plugs, lights, fans; vacuums on/off) and IR appliances (AC with modes, others on/off). Other brands cannot go through it.

maxDevices.note: Support pages say up to 8 Matter sub-devices; its own temperature and humidity sensor counts as one. Source for the number is from a search snippet of SwitchBot support pages; verifier should confirm.

summary: Placeholder summary pending the editor: this record lists what the hub connects to and which ecosystems see those devices. SwitchBot Hub 2 with IR blaster and Matter bridge for SwitchBot devices.
